next_issue.title: feat(schedule): Step 4 - CLI Integration & Rich Terminal Reporting (Milestones & S-Curve)
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Integrate the scheduling engine into the main debim CLI (`debim schedule`) with beautiful Rich terminal reports showing milestone billing status, S-Curve progress, and critical paths.

### Key Deliverables
1. `src/debim/schedule/reporter.py`:
   - `render_schedule_table(result: ScheduleResult) -> Panel`: Rich tables detailing activities, progress badges, and critical path.
   - `render_milestone_table(result: ScheduleResult) -> Panel`: Formatted table showing milestones, required activities, completion dates, and billing readiness status.
   - S-Curve variance summary (e.g. `Ahead by +3.5%` or `Delayed by -5.0%`).
2. `src/debim/cli.py` Integration:
   - `debim schedule init <project.debim> [-o schedule.yaml]`
   - `debim schedule solve <schedule.yaml> [-o schedule.json]`
   - `debim schedule report <schedule.json>`
3. Tests:
   - Unit tests in `tests/test_cli_schedule.py` verifying CLI commands.

### Acceptance Criteria
- `debim schedule init`, `solve`, and `report` execute cleanly via CLI.
- `pytest tests/test_cli_schedule.py` passes 100%.
next_issue.label: jules,enhancement,schedule

next_issue.title: feat(schedule): Step 5 - Standalone Interactive HTML Gantt, S-Curve, Milestone Cards & 4D Viewer
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Create a self-contained, standalone HTML Schedule & 4D Progress Viewer (`schedule.html`) featuring an Interactive Gantt chart, dynamic S-Curve with milestone pins, payment billing cards, and 3D progress visualization.

### Key Deliverables
1. `src/debim/schedule/viewer_html.py`:
   - `generate_schedule_html(schedule_result: ScheduleResult, manifest_obj=None) -> str`:
     - Dynamic S-Curve Chart (SVG/Canvas): Displays Planned Early S-Curve (cyan dashed), Planned Late S-Curve (gray dashed), and Actual S-Curve (emerald solid) with clickable Milestone Pins.
     - Milestone Payment Cards: Cards summarizing each milestone, billing percentage, amount, completion checklist, and 'Ready to Bill' badge.
     - Interactive Gantt Chart: Planned vs Actual dual-bars with Data Date line.
     - 4D BIM Integration (Three.js): Color-coded 3D elements by milestone and progress status (Completed, In Progress, Ghost wireframe) with an interactive Time Slider.
2. CLI Integration in `src/debim/cli.py`:
   - `debim schedule view <schedule.json> [--model project.debim] [-o schedule.html] [--open]`
3. Tests:
   - Unit tests in `tests/test_schedule_viewer.py` verifying HTML generation.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Generates a standalone, zero-external-server HTML viewer that opens cleanly in any browser.
- `pytest tests/test_schedule_viewer.py` passes 100%.
next_issue.label: jules,enhancement,schedule
